The '''Vallusk Cluster''' was a [[Star cluster/Legends|cluster]] of [[Protostar/Legends|protostars]] near [[The Roil/Legends|the Roil]] in the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]] sector of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It lacked habitable [[Planet/Legends|planets]].<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
The Vallusk Cluster was a common location for [[Starship/Legends|starships]] to come out of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] and recalibrate their [[Navigation computer/Legends|navigation computers]] for the trip to [[Arkuda]].<ref name="TEA" />

[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar]] created a [[Battle of the Vallusk Cluster|distraction]] in the Vallusk Cluster, engaging four [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]], so the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] at [[Great Temple/Legends|Massassi Station]] could run the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] blockade of the [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin system]].<ref name="Race for Survival">"[[Race for Survival]]"</ref><ref name="TEA" />
